chunks.title: Meridiam (Meridiam) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Meridiam is a Institutional / Catalytic / Climate PE headquartered in France. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: COP31 Business Forum Climate Finance & Investments Working Group member focusing on bankable resilient urban infrastructure. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Long-term sustainable infrastructure & urban climate resilience investment mandate (25-year impact fund model, active in Türkiye & global municipal PPPs). Source verification: https://www.copbusiness.org/papers/COP31_WG_climate-finance-investments.pdf.

chunks.title: Meridiam Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Meridiam provides the following climate financing instruments: Infrastructure Equity, Municipal PPP Capital, Urban Resilience Fund, Blended Project Preparation. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 5,000,000 to USD 250,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Municipality, Project SPV, Climate-Tech Startup, Large Corporate.

chunks.title: Meridiam Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Meridiam: Resilient Cities & Infrastructure, Urban Mobility & Transport, Zero Waste & Circular Economy, Climate Adaptation & Resilience, Renewable Energy. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Europe, Türkiye, Africa, North America, Emerging Markets. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Meridiam Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Meridiam's application form: Measurable UN SDG & urban climate resilience impact metrics (MRV verified); Public-private partnership (PPP) or municipal concession scalability; Long-term asset durability & Paris Alignment; Strong environmental, social & community governance. Explicit exclusion rules: Coal or fossil-fuel infrastructure; Short-term speculative non-impact ventures. Official application portal: https://www.meridiam.com/.

chunks.title: Meridiam Form Template: Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form
chunks.text: Meridiam uses the 'Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form' workflow governed by GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository / Impact Management Project (IMP) / IRIS+ Climate Metrics. Typical review timeline is 4–10 weeks (Pitch Screening -> Commercial & Climate DD -> IC Approval). Form sections required: 1. Venture / Asset Overview, 2. Investment Thesis, 3. Product & Execution, 4. Impact & Risk, 5. Executive Pitch.
